abstract: This paper specifies a new convenient algorithm to construct policy projections conditional on alternative anticipated policy-rate paths in linearized dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models, such as Ramses, the Riksbank's main DSGE model. Such projections with anticipated policy-rate paths correspond to situations where the central bank transparently announces that it, conditional on current information, plans to implement a particular policy-rate path and where this announced plan for the policy rate is believed and then anticipated by the private sector. The main idea of the algorithm is to include among the predetermined variables (the 'state' of the economy) the vector of nonzero means of future shocks to a given policy rule that is required to satisfy the given anticipated policy-rate path.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的便捷算法，用于在线性化动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型（如瑞典央行的主要DSGE模型Ramses）中，构建基于替代性预期政策利率路径的政策预测。此类包含预期政策利率路径的预测，对应于中央银行在现有信息条件下透明地宣布其计划实施特定政策利率路径，且该宣布的政策利率计划被私人部门相信并预期的情况。该算法的核心思想是，在预定变量（即经济“状态”）中纳入未来对给定政策规则冲击的非零均值向量，该向量需满足给定的预期政策利率路径。
title: Anticipated Alternative Instrument-Rate Paths in Policy Simulations
title_zh: DP8176 政策模拟中预期的替代性利率路径

abstract: Stochastic general equilibrium models of small open economies with occasionally binding financial frictions are capable of mimicking both the business cycles and the crisis events associated with the sudden stop in access to credit markets (Mendoza, 2010). In this paper we study the inefficiencies associated with borrowing decisions in a two-sector small open production economy. We find that this economy is much more likely to display "under-borrowing" rather than "over-borrowing" in normal times. As a result, macro-prudential policies (i.e. Tobin taxes or economy-wide controls on capital inflows) are costly in welfare terms in our economy. Moreover, we show that macro-prudential policies aimed at minimizing the probability of the crisis event might be welfare-reducing. Our analysis shows that there is a much larger scope for welfare gains from policy interventions during financial crises. That is to say that, within our modelling approach, ex post or crisis-management policies dominate ex ante or macro-prudential ones.
abstract_zh: 具有偶尔约束性金融摩擦的小型开放经济体的随机一般均衡模型，能够模拟与信贷市场准入突然停止相关的经济周期和危机事件（Mendoza, 2010）。本文研究了两部门小型开放生产经济中借贷决策相关的低效率问题。我们发现，在正常时期，该经济体更可能出现"借贷不足"而非"借贷过度"的现象。因此，宏观审慎政策（如托宾税或对资本流入的全面控制）在我们的经济体中会产生福利成本。此外，我们证明，旨在最小化危机事件发生概率的宏观审慎政策可能反而降低福利。我们的分析表明，在金融危机期间，政策干预带来的福利收益空间要大得多。也就是说，在我们的建模框架内，事后或危机管理政策优于事前或宏观审慎政策。
title: Financial Crisis and Macro-Prudential Policies
title_zh: 金融危机与宏观审慎政策

abstract: It is customary to suggest that the asymmetry in the transmission of oil price shocks to real output is well established. Much of the empirical work cited as being in support of asymmetries, however, has not directly tested the hypothesis of an asymmetric transmission of oil price innovations. Moreover, many of the papers quantifying these asymmetric responses are based on censored oil price VAR models which recently have been shown to be invalid. Other studies are based on dynamic correlations in the data that do not shed light on the central question of whether the structural responses of real output triggered by positive and negative oil price innovations are asymmetric. Recently, a number of new methodologies have been introduced and applied to the problem of testing and quantifying asymmetric responses of U.S. real economic activity to positive and negative oil price innovations. Our objective is to put this literature in perspective, to contrast it with more traditional approaches, to highlight directions for further research, and to reconcile some seemingly conflicting results reported in the literature.
abstract_zh: 通常认为，石油价格冲击对实际产出的非对称传导已得到充分证实。然而，多数被引证支持非对称性的实证研究并未直接检验石油价格冲击的非对称传导假设。此外，许多量化这些非对称响应的论文基于经审查的石油价格VAR模型，而此类模型近期已被证明无效。另一些研究则依赖数据中的动态相关性，未能阐明核心问题——即正向与负向石油价格冲击所引发的实际产出结构性响应是否具有非对称性。近年来，一系列新方法被引入并应用于检验与量化美国实际经济活动对正负石油价格冲击的非对称响应。本文旨在系统梳理该领域文献，将其与传统方法进行对比，指出未来研究方向，并调和文献中看似矛盾的若干结论。
title: Nonlinearities in the Oil Price-Output Relationship
title_zh: 石油价格与产出关系中的非线性特征

abstract: Trade and investment in services is inhibited by a range of policy restrictions, but the best offers so far in the Doha negotiations are on average twice as restrictive as actual policy. They will generate no additional market opening. Regulatory concerns help explain the limited progress. We develop two proposals to enhance the prospects for both liberalization of services trade and regulatory reform. The first is for governments to create mechanisms ('services knowledge platforms') to bring together regulators, trade officials and stakeholders to discuss services regulatory reform. Such mechanisms could identify reform priorities and opportunities for utilization of 'aid for trade' resources, thereby putting in place the preconditions for future market opening. The second proposal is for a new approach to negotiations in the WTO, with a critical mass of countries that account for the bulk of services production agreeing to lock-in applied levels of protection and pre-committing to reform of policies affecting FDI and international movement for individual service providers--two areas where current policy is most restrictive and potential benefits from liberalization are greatest. If these proposals cannot be fully implemented in the Doha time frame, then any Doha agreement could at least lay the basis for a forward-looking program of international cooperation along the proposed lines.
abstract_zh: 服务贸易与投资受到一系列政策限制的制约，但多哈谈判迄今提出的最佳方案平均限制程度是实际政策的两倍，这些方案不会带来额外的市场开放。监管方面的顾虑有助于解释为何进展有限。我们提出两项建议，以促进服务贸易自由化与监管改革的前景。第一项建议是，各国政府应建立机制（"服务知识平台"），将监管机构、贸易官员和利益相关方聚集在一起，讨论服务监管改革。此类机制可确定改革优先事项以及利用"贸易援助"资源的机会，从而为未来的市场开放创造前提条件。第二项建议是，在世贸组织谈判中采取新方法，由占服务生产绝大部分的关键多数国家同意锁定现行保护水平，并预先承诺改革影响外国直接投资和个体服务提供者国际流动的政策——这两个领域是目前政策限制最严格、自由化潜在收益最大的领域。如果这些建议无法在多哈时间框架内完全实施，那么任何多哈协议至少可以为按照拟议方向开展前瞻性国际合作计划奠定基础。
title: Services Trade Liberalization and Regulatory Reform: Re-invigorating International Cooperation
title_zh: 服务贸易自由化与监管改革：重振国际合作

abstract: According to conventional wisdom, fiscal policy is more effective under a fixed than under a flexible exchange rate regime. In this paper we reconsider the transmission of shocks to government spending across these regimes within a standard new-Keynesian model of a small open economy. Because of the stronger emphasis on intertemporal optimization, the new-Keynesian framework requires a precise specification of fiscal and monetary policies, and their interaction, at both short and long horizons. We derive an analytical characterization of the transmission mechanism of expansionary spending policies under a peg, showing that the long-term real interest rate necessarily rises if inflation rises on impact, in response to an increase in government spending. This drives down private demand even though short-term real rates fall. As this need not be the case under floating exchange rates, the conventional wisdom needs to be qualified. Under plausible medium-term fiscal policies, government spending is not necessarily less expansionary under floating exchange rates.
abstract_zh: 根据传统观点，固定汇率制度下的财政政策比浮动汇率制度下更有效。本文在标准的新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型中重新审视了这两种汇率制度下政府支出冲击的传导机制。由于新凯恩斯框架更强调跨期优化，因此需要精确界定短期和长期内的财政政策、货币政策及其相互作用。我们通过分析推导了钉住汇率制度下扩张性支出政策的传导机制特征，表明若政府支出增加导致通胀即时上升，长期实际利率必然随之上升。尽管短期实际利率下降，但长期利率上升仍会抑制私人需求。由于浮动汇率制度下未必出现此现象，传统观点需要加以修正。在合理的中期财政政策条件下，浮动汇率制度下的政府支出扩张效应未必更弱。
title: Floats, pegs and the transmission of fiscal policy
title_zh: 浮动汇率、固定汇率与财政政策的传导

abstract: The paper studies how high leverage and crises can arise as a result of changes in the income distribution. Empirically, the periods 1920-1929 and 1983-2007 both exhibited a large increase in the income share of the rich, a large increase in leverage for the remainder, and an eventual financial and real crisis. The paper presents a theoretical model where these features arise endogenously as a result of a shift in bargaining powers over incomes. A financial crisis can reduce leverage if it is very large and not accompanied by a real contraction. But restoration of the lower income group?s bargaining power is more effective.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了收入分配变化如何导致高杠杆和危机的产生。实证分析表明，1920-1929年与1983-2007年两个时期均呈现以下特征：富裕阶层收入份额大幅上升，其余群体杠杆率显著提高，并最终引发金融与实体经济危机。本文构建了一个理论模型，揭示这些特征如何因收入议价能力的转变而内生形成。金融危机会在规模极大且未伴随实体经济收缩时降低杠杆率，但恢复低收入群体的议价能力更为有效。
title: Inequality, Leverage and Crises

abstract: This paper compares two policies: trade cost reduction and firm relocation cost reduction using a three-country version of a heterogeneous-firms economic geography model, where the three countries have different market (population) size. We show how the effects of the two policies differ, in particular, for the country of intermediate size. Unless the intermediate country is very small, it will gain industry when relocation costs are reduced, but lose industry when trade costs are reduced. The smallest country loses industry in both cases, but only experiences lower welfare in the case of lower relocation costs. Thus, the ranking of the policies from the point of view of the two small and intermediate countries tends to be the opposite.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含三个国家的异质性企业经济地理模型，比较了贸易成本降低与企业迁移成本降低两种政策的效果。其中，三个国家具有不同的市场规模（人口规模）。我们揭示了这两种政策效应的差异，尤其聚焦于中等规模国家。除非中等规模国家非常小，否则当迁移成本降低时，该国将获得产业增长；而当贸易成本降低时，该国将面临产业流失。最小规模国家在两种情形下均会失去产业，但仅在迁移成本降低时遭遇福利下降。因此，从两个小国和中等规模国家的视角来看，两种政策的优劣排序往往呈现相反趋势。
title: On the development strategy of countries of intermediate size - An analysis of heterogenous firms in a multiregion framework
title_zh: 中等规模国家发展战略研究——基于多区域框架下的异质性企业分析

abstract: This paper provides first and second-order approximation methods for the solution of non-linear dynamic stochastic models in which the exogenous state variables follow conditionally-linear stochastic processes displaying time-varying risk. The first-order approximation is consistent with a conditionally-linear model in which risk is still time-varying but has no distinct role - separated from the primitive stochastic disturbances- in influencing the endogenous variables. The second-order approximation of the solution, instead, is sufficient to get this role. Moreover, risk premia, evaluated using only a first-order approximation of the solution, will be also time varying.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了求解非线性动态随机模型的一阶和二阶近似方法，其中外生状态变量遵循具有时变风险的条件线性随机过程。一阶近似与条件线性模型一致，在该模型中风险虽仍具有时变性，但在影响内生变量方面并未发挥独立于原始随机扰动的独特作用。而解的二阶近似则足以体现这一作用。此外，仅使用解的一阶近似评估的风险溢价也将呈现时变性。

title: Second Order Approximation of Dynamic Models with Time-Varying Risk
title_zh: 时变风险动态模型的二阶近似
